title: Im just blown away by what you can do now
author: Advice2Anyone
selftext: So been coding most of my life and always been really into incremental games specially the math involved. I have made this game before spent about a month writing it and once it was up there were bugs that would take me hours of learning how things interfaced, stuff that was just not intuitive and eventually became discouraged and between having to work out the math progressions, trouble shooting and rebalancing it eventually just became abandoned. But this is day 3 of me getting it out there again and I already am past the point that it would have taken me a month to get to 10 years ago. Still requires a lot of tinkering to get the math floors right but now I can focus on building out the actual game mechanics without getting bogged down.
